jobgether-jobgether:lever:8eadd01a-429f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer (AWS) based in United States. This is a senior infrastructure engineering role focused on designing, operating, and continuously improving reliable AWS environments. You will work hands-on across cloud infrastructure, networking, infrastructure as code, containers, automation, and observability. The role combines technical ownership with independent problem-solving and a strong commitment to operational excellence. You will help ensure infrastructure remains secure, scalable, resilient, and well documented across complex environments. As a senior team member, you will collaborate closely with engineering teams while mentoring peers and helping resolve challenging technical issues. Demonstrate independent discovery and ownership when addressing complex infrastructure challenges, while contributing to team priorities and mentoring other engineers. Operate effectively in a fast-paced remote environment, balancing competing priorities and maintaining clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Requirements 4+ years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or a closely related technical discipline. jobgether-jobgether:lever:abdb84db-c443-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project / Product Manager — PSP & Payment Integrations based in Switzerland. This role is ideal for a hands-on payments professional who understands payment integrations beyond the project-management layer. You will lead the end-to-end integration of PSPs, payment providers, and payment methods, from reviewing API documentation and configuring sandbox environments through testing, production launch, and post-release stabilization. You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, QA, business stakeholders, and external payment partners. The role combines delivery ownership with practical knowledge of APIs, transaction flows, authentication, webhooks, and payment operations. You will help shape priorities, manage dependencies, and ensure integrations are delivered reliably and efficiently. This is an environment with significant ownership, international payment infrastructure, and exposure to a broad range of providers and payment methods. Lead end-to-end integrations with new PSPs, payment providers, acquiring partners, and payment methods, from initial technical review through production launch and stabilization. Review API documentation and understand integration flows, including authentication, API keys, signatures, requests/responses, webhooks, callbacks, and transaction statuses. Translate integration requirements into clear, actionable tasks for Development and QA teams. Coordinate credentials, environments, merchant configuration, technical dependencies, blockers, testing activities, and release readiness. Collaborate closely with developers, QA specialists, business stakeholders, and external payment providers to keep integrations on track. Oversee sandbox, staging, and production testing, troubleshooting issues and coordinating post-release stabilization when required. Manage the payment integration backlog in Jira, including Epics, Tasks, dependencies, priorities, and Jira Plans. Plan delivery timelines and team capacity while maintaining visibility of risks, dependencies, and progress. Maintain accurate and accessible integration documentation in Confluence. Contribute to prioritization decisions around payment providers, integrations, and payment methods. Use a practical understanding of payment lifecycles, reconciliation, and financial flows to support effective delivery and issue resolution. Requirements Demonstrated hands-on experience with PSPs, payment gateways, acquiring, or payment processing , with direct involvement in payment provider integrations. Proven experience personally taking payment integrations from provider documentation and technical setup through testing and production launch, rather than managing them only at a high level. Strong understanding of REST APIs, request/response logic, webhooks, callbacks, authentication mechanisms, signatures, and API keys. Practical knowledge of deposits, payouts, transaction statuses, status mapping, sandbox/staging/production environments, error handling, and integration troubleshooting. Understanding of reconciliation and basic financial flows within payment processing. Experience coordinating cross-functional delivery across Product, Development, QA, business teams, and external payment providers. Experience with Jira and Confluence, including backlog management, prioritization, dependencies, documentation, and planning. Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, timelines, and technical dependencies. Ability to independently explain a payment lifecycle and the technical flow of a provider integration. Experience in iGaming, betting, crypto, or forex payments is a strong advantage. jobgether-jobgether:lever:bc41334b-b0aa-.title: Solutions Architect
jobgether-jobgether:lever:bc41334b-b0aa-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Architect based in Canada. This is a customer-facing technical leadership role focused on designing cloud infrastructure and MLOps solutions for AI and machine learning teams. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers transform complex requirements into scalable, high-performance cloud architectures. The role combines hands-on architecture, infrastructure as code, GPU computing, Kubernetes, and Python development with strategic customer engagement. You’ll lead proofs of concept, workshops, technical presentations, and training sessions while helping customers optimize their AI pipelines. Working remotely from Canada, you’ll collaborate closely with customers and internal product, support, marketing, and engineering teams. You’ll also contribute technical expertise to industry events, hackathons, conferences, webinars, and other community initiatives. This is an opportunity to work on impactful AI infrastructure projects within a fast-moving, international environment where ownership and innovation are highly valued. Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, providing architecture guidance and expertise throughout engagements involving cloud infrastructure and MLOps. Conduct proofs of concept, workshops, presentations, and training sessions focused on GPU cloud technologies, AI/ML infrastructure, and industry best practices. Work directly with customers to understand business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable, effective solution architectures. Design and document Infrastructure-as-Code solutions, technical architectures, implementation guides, and how-to documentation in collaboration with support engineers and technical writers. Help customers optimize AI/ML pipelines for performance, scalability, reliability, and efficient utilization of cloud resources. Serve as the primary technical expert for customer use cases, communicating insights and requirements to product, technical support, and marketing teams. Contribute technical expertise to marketing and community initiatives, including hackathons, conferences, workshops, webinars, and industry events. Stay current with developments in cloud infrastructure, GPU computing, MLOps, and AI technologies to continuously improve customer solutions. Requirements: 5–10+ years of experience as a Cloud Solutions Architect, Systems or Network Engineer, Developer, or similar technical professional focused on cloud computing. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent international qualification in a relevant field, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience. Strong hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and configuration management , preferably Terraform and Ansible. Practical experience with Kubernetes and proficiency in Python or a comparable programming environment. Solid understanding of GPU computing for machine learning training and inference workloads, including GPU software stack components such as drivers, CUDA, and OpenCL. Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, combined with a highly customer-centric mindset. Ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and build trusted relationships with customers and internal stakeholders. Experience with HPC or ML orchestration frameworks such as Slurm or Kubeflow is an advantage. Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is beneficial. Familiarity with the broader cloud ML ecosystem and technologies from providers such as NVIDIA, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud is a plus. Benefits: CAD $235,000–$300,000 On-Target Earnings , with actual compensation determined by experience, skills, qualifications, level, and geographic location. C

thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.description: Job description Take the next step toward your future with The Urology Group in Cincinnati! Our growing Northern Kentucky clinic is seeking a Physician Assistant or Nurse Practitioner to join the team in 2026. What’s the Scoop? Location: Position is located at our Crestview Hills office! Work: Outpatient-focused with some daily inpatient rounds (because variety is the spice of life). Schedule: 4.5 days a week—hello, long weekends! Pay: Guaranteed base salary + bonuses based on net receipts (cha-ching!). Why Crestview Hills? Known as the “Home of Thomas More University,” Crestview Hills offers a lifestyle that’s rich in community, rolling landscapes, and suburban charm. Here's why you’ll want to make Crestview Hills your new home base: Accessibility: It’s a commuter’s dream! Perfectly positioned at the I-275 and I-75 interchange, making a trip to downtown Cincinnati or CVG Airport a breeze. Housing: From stately brick traditionals in quiet cul-de-sacs to modern maintenance-free condos, we’ve got your vibe covered—and with a neighborhood feel that’s second to none. Education: Top-tier opportunities abound with the highly-rated Kenton County Schools and the prestigious Thomas More University right in your backyard. Food & Drink: Hunger doesn’t stand a chance. With the Crestview Hills Town Center at the heart of the city, you’ll find everything from local favorites like Taste of Belgium to upscale bistro dining. Sports: Whether you’re hitting the courts at Five Seasons Family Sports Club or cheering on the Thomas More Saints, the local athletic spirit is alive and well. Parks & Outdoors: Scenic beauty everywhere! From the walking paths at Freedom Park to the lush greens of Summit Hills Country Club, there’s more fresh air than you’ll know what to do with. Culture: From the popular Summer Concert Series at the mall to university lectures and seasonal festivals, Crestview Hills is buzzing with a sophisticated, close-knit energy year-round. Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level. Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence. True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients. Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage. Outcomes Matter. Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide. Interested in learning more? We are just a click away. No pressure. Just information and a partnership built for physicians who want to lead the future of specialty care. Be empowered to make your best next career move! The Specialty Alliance is a physician-led Management Services Organization (MSO) that supports leading specialty practices with national-scale infrastructure, data, and resources.
